result.brief: 提出事件对齐的视觉动作推理框架，按交互事件组织世界动作模型的视觉想象粒度，并引入执行有效性头，提升机器人操作成功率与跨层级迁移。
result.reason: World-Action Model using future visual prediction as intermediate reasoning for action generation; event-aligned visual-action supervision shapes visual foresight representation, a world-model contribution.
